title: Sandia DOE Reference Model Project
reviewed_sections: RM1 linked resource, performance and experimental documents
supported_claims: The programme identifies reference geometry, resource, experimental and cost-model materials for RM1 and other reference models.
limitations: Some download bundles require submitting a form; no source measurements were downloaded.

title: DOE RM1: Experimental Results — Hill et al.
reviewed_sections: report printed pp.3-10 experimental setup, processing and uncertainty
report printed pp.12-13 turbine performance and blockage limits
report printed p.20 Appendix A 32 tabulated right/left rotor operating points
supported_claims: The report documents RM1 experimental methodology and reported combined power-coefficient measurement uncertainty of approximately 3.9%.
Appendix A permits reproducing 16 Cp-vs-TSR performance points per rotor and checking nominal torque-rotation mechanical power, but no directly measured turbine thrust
Right-rotor tabulated Cp peak 0.477; left rotor max 0.412 while report text gives approximate left Cp peak 0.43
limitations: Selected experimental sections and Appendix A reviewed; NOT a full-report deep review, no raw torque and velocity series or independently validated model.
2014 introduction mistakenly labels RM1 as RM2; do not propagate.
TSR and Cp from printed table have limited precision and source Cp does not equal a simple ratio of printed mean values.
Thrust and Ct are n/a in Appendix A; RM1 does not demonstrate fatigue-life benefit.
access_status: Public Sandia PDF with readable performance table and graphical appendix; PDF p.20 screenshot inspected.

title: RealTide Deliverable 1.1 FMEA report
supported_claims: Four generic concept decompositions examined; electrical, rotor and drivetrain systems are important criticality priorities.
FMEA component/mode counts differ by concept complexity and do not measure actual failure probabilities.
limitations: Report is 198 pages, not fully reviewed; ordinal/constructed risk assessments cannot establish measured service life.

title: Orbital Marine technology page
supported_claims: Orbital describes a floating/retractable-leg service-access concept.
limitations: Claims of service cost advantage are developer promotional statements, not independently verified comparisons.

title: D2T2 Accelerator — Nova Innovation project periodic reporting
reviewed_sections: project information and 2019-2020 periodic report summary
supported_claims: Nova reported direct-drive M100-D development and lower cost targets.
limitations: Statements in EC-hosted partner reporting must not be treated as independent comparative LCOE, availability, or failure-rate evidence.

title: Gambuzza et al., Model-scale experiments of passive pitch control
supported_claims: One passively pitching blade on a 1.2m model-scale turbine reduced root-bending-moment fluctuation by 15–45% over investigated tip-speed ratios, per the paper.
Spring and bearing friction and preload could erode benefits and increase mean loading.
limitations: Not a full-scale endurance, MTBF or lifetime-cost experiment; inflow conditions and uncertainties must be replayed before generalization.

title: Minesto Deep Green technology

title: HydroQuest tidal turbines and services

title: Bachant et al UNH RM2 1:6 tow-tank processed performance data
reviewed_sections: README: turbine specifications, test-matrix nomenclature and licence
Data/Processed/Perf-1.0.csv: all 23 lines and uncertainty fields
pyrm2tt/processing.py: upstream definitions, D*H area and density
supported_claims: Processed 1.0 m/s tow-tank Cp/CD data have 23 runs; measured peak Cp ~0.35460 near TSR 3.099; upstream data derivative reproduces those values.
limitations: This is a 1:6 model tow-tank experiment, not a Fundy site or a predictive model. Upstream source full file can be independently checked using immutable blob SHA. ~10 GB raw instrument archive was not acquired.
access_status: MIT code; CC BY 4.0 other materials

publication_date: 2014 (Sandia report; secondary site entry may use 2017)

title: Viehman et al. Integrated Hydroacoustic Approaches to Predict Fish Interactions with In-stream Tidal Turbines (FORCE/OERA final report)
reviewed_sections: PDF pp.5-8 (deployment and instrument methods, including sec.3.2.2)
PDF pp.15-16 (sec.3.4.1 ADCP currents quality treatment and declination correction)
supported_claims: FAST3 platform included an upward-looking Nortek Signature 500 ADCP in March-May 2018; five-minute bursts every 15 minutes, 2-Hz burst rate.
Reported treatment of ADCP data includes estimating water surface from echo amplitude and excluding top 10% of the column for sidelobes during project analyses.
North/east component rotation in the published processed ERDDAP product needs separate lineage confirmation before any additional direction adjustment.
limitations: The report does not provide explicit instrument serial-specific head height above seafloor for public ERDDAP product, beam correlation/percent-good for individual cell records or a direct zero-fill convention.
Report describes original SDU processing; cannot conclude published ERDDAP ENU has or has not applied declination without transformation code.
Automated page images from primary report were access-blocked; reviewed text extraction and source identification, not visually verified figure geometry.
access_status: Public PDF text and primary metadata accessible; images intermittently 403; reviewed stated sections only.
